summary: Erdem's research is about AGI: what happens to the workforce when it arrives, and how people find meaning when work changes. It's the deep end of everything on this channel.

threads.title: AGI
threads.question: What changes when machines can do most cognitive work, and how fast?
threads.why: It's the frontier behind every tool video. 'AI is building AI' is already the premise of your Delivery Pilot video.

threads.title: The workforce
threads.question: Which jobs shrink, which grow, and how do people move between them?
threads.why: This is your strongest content pillar: data-backed career takes. Sources you've already used on camera include SignalFire's new-grad hiring data, the Harvard study of 62M workers, and Brynjolfsson's productivity J-curve.

threads.title: Meaning
threads.question: When work is no longer the main source of identity, where do people find meaning?
threads.why: This is the human half of 'AI × human intelligence', and the thread that connects your ikigai, Hawkins' map, Lacan and Tony Robbins' belief work.

bridge.title: 🧑‍✈️ The bridge: the Delivery Pilot
bridge.text: The research question meets the channel here. If AGI takes the tasks, people keep the judgment, the delivery and the meaning. The Delivery Pilot is one practical answer to 'what do I do now?', and the 90-day flight plan is how someone gets there.

toChannel.title: One video per thread
toChannel.detail: Three Pillar 2 long videos: 'What AGI Actually Changes', 'Who Gets Hired After AGI (Data)', 'Finding Meaning When AI Does the Work'. Each one cites the paper.

toChannel.title: The Pilot's Log season arc
toChannel.detail: Season 1 of the sci-fi series follows the paper: a ship where agents do the work, and a crew finding out what's left for humans.

toChannel.title: Comic strips of the findings
toChannel.detail: One finding per strip as a LinkedIn carousel. It's how a research paper reaches 30k connections.

toChannel.title: Skool reading group
toChannel.detail: Walk members through the paper chapter by chapter in Sunday Lives, then discuss their own meaning and work questions.

toChannel.title: Credibility for the story
toChannel.detail: 'Tried university twice, now writing research on AGI and work' is the Susan Boyle reveal, backed by real work.
